name: Tata Power Co.
about: Tata Power Co. Ltd. is a leading integrated power company in India, with a diverse portfolio spanning thermal, hydro, solar, and wind energy generation. It is actively involved in electricity transmission and distribution across various regions, serving millions of customers. Tata Power is committed to promoting clean energy solutions, with significant investments in solar and wind power, aligning with global sustainability goals. The company also focuses on energy storage, electric vehicle charging infrastructure, and microgrid development. Through its innovation-driven approach, Tata Power aims to lead the energy transition in India, providing reliable, sustainable, and affordable power solutions to communities and businesses.
